subtitle: A mushroom, brie and cranberry Wellington with traditional roast accompaniments, suited to vegetarians who enjoy rich pastry and cheese.

taste:
The Wellington combines earthy mushrooms, creamy melted brie and sweet cranberries inside a crisp puff pastry lattice. That contrast is its main appeal: flaky pastry gives way to a soft, cheese-rich filling, while the fruit introduces sweetness among the savoury flavours. Expect a rich centrepiece rather than a simple vegetable-led roast, particularly if brie is what draws you to the dish.

It is served piping hot with crisp roast potatoes, seasonal vegetables, a Yorkshire pudding and rich vegetarian gravy. The potatoes echo the pastry’s crisp texture, while the gravy adds another savoury element. For diners who enjoy cheese, mushrooms and fruit together, the filling offers more contrast than any ingredient alone.
value:
The typical price is {price}, but the value depends on your pub’s price and how much you enjoy the mushroom, brie and cranberry combination. Roast potatoes, seasonal vegetables, a Yorkshire pudding and vegetarian gravy are included, so compare it as a complete roast rather than pastry alone.

Roast Beef, Roast Chicken Breast and Roast Pork are alternatives in the same section. Vegan Wellington is the other meat-free option to compare. Check local prices before choosing, particularly if dietary requirements matter more to you than the filling.

dietaryGuidance:
The Vegetarian Wellington is tagged vegetarian, but it is not a vegan choice because the filling includes brie. Our [allergen data](/allergen-information) lists cereals containing gluten, eggs and milk. Diners avoiding any of these should check the current allergen information with the pub before ordering.

Do not assume the vegetarian label addresses allergies or other dietary restrictions. Swaps and changes to accompaniments can alter the allergens in your order, so confirm the complete plate. Vegan Wellington is listed separately, but its suitability for your requirements needs checking too.
